title: pvImageReader
body:
## pvImageReader

Reads headerless raw binary voxel files (.raw) into uniform image data. The file carries no metadata, so you describe it: DataExtent (index ranges), DataScalarType, DataByteOrder, NumberOfScalarComponents and FileDimensionality, plus DataSpacing and DataOrigin for world placement. Several files are a time series unless ReadAsImageStack stacks 2-D files as z slices. Use pvNrrdReader or pvMetaFileSeriesReader when a header file exists.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- DataExtent starts as all zeros, which describes a single voxel; always set it, e.g. [0, 255, 0, 255, 0, 99] for 256 x 256 x 100 voxels.
- A wrong scalar type or byte order (ParaView defaults: short, BigEndian) still yields an image, only with nonsense values; check the value range after reading.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ImageReader`. Identity: `sources/ImageReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataByteOrder` | This property indicates the byte order of the binary file(s). | `{"type":"enum","values":["BigEndian","LittleEndian"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"BigEndian"` |
| `DataExtent` | This property specifies the minimum and maximum index values of the data in each dimension (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax). | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `DataOrigin` | The coordinate contained in this property specifies the position of the point with index (0,0,0). | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `DataScalarType` | The value of this property indicates the scalar type of the pixels/voxels in the file(s): short, int, float ... | `{"type":"enum","values":["char","unsigned char","short","unsigned short","int","unsigned int","long","unsigned long","float","double"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"char"` |
| `DataSpacing` | This property specifies the size of a voxel in each dimension. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `FileDimensionality` | This property indicates whether the file(s) in this dataset contain slices (2D) or volumes (3D). | `{"type":"enum","values":["2","3"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"2"` |
| `FileLowerLeft` | This property determines whether the data originates in the lower left corner (on) or the upper left corner (off). Most scientific data is written with a right-handed axes that originates in the lower left corner. However, several 2D image file formats write the image from the upper left corner. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. If more than one file is specified, the reader will switch to file series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `NumberOfScalarComponents` | This property specifies the number of components the scalar value at each pixel or voxel has (e.g., RGB - 3 scalar components). | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ReadAsImageStack` | When set, the reader will read the set of files as an image stack, rather than a temporal file series. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ScalarArrayName` | This property contains a text string listing a name to assign to the point-centered data array read. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvImageReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
